answers.1:
mariadb shop -e 'SELECT c.name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.id IS NULL;' > /tmp/q1.txt
cat /tmp/q1.txt

# 왼쪽(고객)은 모두 남고, 주문이 없는 고객은 o.id 가 NULL 이다
answers.2:
mariadb shop -e "SELECT c.name, p.name AS product, o.qty FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE c.name = 'park'" > /tmp/q2.txt
cat /tmp/q2.txt

# orders 에 customers, products 를 각각 JOIN 하고 WHERE 로 고객을 좁힌다
answers.3:
mariadb shop -e 'SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;' > /tmp/q3.txt
cat /tmp/q3.txt

# 고객별로 묶은 뒤 HAVING 으로 건수 2 이상인 그룹만 남긴다
answers.4:
mariadb shop -e 'SELECT name FROM products WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products);' > /tmp/q4.txt
cat /tmp/q4.txt

# 서브쿼리가 평균을 먼저 구하고, 바깥 쿼리가 그보다 비싼 행을 고른다
answers.5:
mariadb shop -e "SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id IN (SELECT o.customer_id FROM orders o JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE p.category = 'electronics')" > /tmp/q5.txt
cat /tmp/q5.txt

# IN 서브쿼리로 electronics 를 주문한 고객 번호 목록을 만들고 그 안의 고객만 고른다
answers.6:
mariadb shop -e "SELECT name, CASE WHEN price >= 100000 THEN 'high' WHEN price >= 10000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS grade FROM products" > /tmp/q6.txt
cat /tmp/q6.txt

# CASE 는 위에서부터 처음 맞는 WHEN 의 값을 쓰므로 큰 기준부터 적는다
answers.7:
mariadb shop -e 'SELECT p.name, SUM(p.price * o.qty) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3;' > /tmp/q7.txt
cat /tmp/q7.txt

# JOIN 으로 가격과 수량을 이어 붙이고, 상품별 SUM 을 큰 순서로 3개만
answers.8:
mariadb shop -e "CREATE VIEW order_detail AS SELECT o.id, c.name AS customer, p.name AS product, o.qty FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id;"
mariadb shop -e 'SELECT * FROM order_detail;'

# CREATE VIEW 이름 AS SELECT ... 로 저장하고, 이후에는 테이블처럼 SELECT 한다
answers.9:
mariadb shop -e 'SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS buyers FROM orders;' > /tmp/q9.txt
cat /tmp/q9.txt

# COUNT(DISTINCT 컬럼) 은 서로 다른 값만 센다
